title: Apple unveils an Apple Intelligence feature that can automatically change compromised passwords, using agentic AI, and save them to the Passwords app (James Pero/Gizmodo)
summary: James Pero / Gizmodo: Apple unveils an Apple Intelligence feature that can automatically change compromised passwords, using agentic AI, and save them to the Passwords app — Agentic AI and security are normally at odds, but this Apple Intelligence feature could be a lifesaver.
contentText:
James Pero / Gizmodo :

Apple unveils an Apple Intelligence feature to automatically change compromised passwords, using agentic AI, and save them to the Passwords app   —  Agentic AI and security are normally at odds, but this Apple Intelligence feature could be a lifesaver.  —  As important as being secure …
